title: NLEx dredges, widens 20 km of Pampanga rivers to curb flooding

blocks.text: CITY OF SAN FERNANDO — The North Luzon Expressway (NLEx) Corp. has dredged and widened around 20 kilometers of three rivers in Pampanga province as part of efforts to prevent floods and slow traffic on the toll road. NLEx Corp. president and general manager Luis Reñon provided the update during a briefing with Pampanga Gov. Lilia Pineda and Vice Gov. Dennis Pineda at the provincial capitol on Monday, Oct. 12. Dredging and widening works covered the stretches of the Tulaoc and Pankiyari rivers in San Simon town and Pau River in Santo Tomas town since September when monsoons rains and typhoons […]...
